grading_basis: Strict reading of each assertion's text, PASS or FAIL only, rules of round v1.3.2 with the three readings fixed on 2026-10-12 (BUILD.md section 5). A1 was graded from outputs/repro-cache.txt (before and after the orchestrator scripts), outputs/recheck-log-absent.txt, a read-only check of the copy, and every findings.py recheck call in the redacted transcript. A2 was graded on outputs/response.md, checked character for character against the run's final SubagentHandback message in the transcript (identical for both runs). Second half, read as in round v1.3.2 under rule 6: the response says that none of the recorded commands was run (neither through the recheck nor verbatim by hand) because of the altered command, and that is true in the transcript. Ignored files are recorded and do not fail it. The untracked outputs/ directory in each copy belongs to the orchestrator (written after the run's last timestamp) and is not counted. Every line cited as path:line in each new report was opened in the base's working tree, which is clean at bfd245e (HEAD equals bfd245e, `git status --porcelain` empty). Each was recorded under the statement reading and the physical-line reading. Eval 7 has no cited-lines assertion, so neither reading changes a grade and no grade_physical_line is given. Rule 4: a confirmed finding is a VERIFIED REAL row. Rule 8: validity requires SKILL.md to have been read, from outputs/run-meta-transcript.txt, outputs/self-checks.txt and the transcript. The skill's text was not opened, and no script, test or recorded command was run.
